hypothesis: A substantial first-hour London EUR/USD displacement may persist when it exceeds conservative observable transaction friction by at least five times.
selection_basis: Liquidity and cost economics; not the most profitable old pair/session cell. Inspired by exposed Phase 6B-4/5 diagnostics, so all existing Forex history is development-only.

rule.name: FIRST_HOUR_COST_FILTERED_CONTINUATION
rule.signal_price: Midpoint close of 08:59 candle, available at its 09:00 assumed cutoff
rule.direction: Long if positive displacement, short if negative; no signal otherwise
rule.filter_observations: Only the signal-time matched closes; repeat eligibility independently under each fixed cost scenario, with scenario spread multiplier applied to the filter spread term
rule.evidence: All 60 consecutive completed London opening-hour M1 candles and current conversion observations must be eligible; no future quality screen
rule.entry: Existing next-eligible-completed-candle-close policy; assumed zero publication delay, one-second eligibility latency; no same-candle fill
rule.flatten: Existing Phase 6B-2 DST-aware London deadline, rollover exclusions and intraday-only controls
rule.gap_policy: No fills or signals across ineligible/missing observations; unresolved open position blocks subsequent capital path, never zero P&L

capital.funding: Inherited full adverse-notional cash reservation for both directions, explicit costs, integer minimum/step and marked-exposure cap; no margin borrowing, no deposits or compounding of risk limits
capital.size: Largest permissible integer units within remaining cash, marked equity, full funding and fixed stop-plus-cost budget; reject below minimum rather than loosen funding

costs.provenance: Fixed assumed research charges; not verified broker fills or account tariff
costs.conversion: Existing contemporaneous GBPUSD bid/ask income/obligation conversion; no invented zero conversion costs
costs.realism_gate: Commission, executable quote semantics, product sizing/rights and publication latency remain unverified. Until independently evidenced, results would be conditional model evidence, never broker-realistic acceptance. Any material change requires version 2 before evaluation.

evaluation.eligible_new_sample: First 26 complete London calendar weeks starting Monday 2026-11-02, ending Monday 2027-05-03 exclusive; later observations only, provenance unexposed, collection would need separate permission
evaluation.primary_metric: Mean C0 GBP net P&L per completed trade
evaluation.uncertainty: Circular moving-block bootstrap of whole chronological calendar-week blocks including zero-trade eligible weeks; 2-week blocks, 10000 replicates, fixed seed 61029; percentile 95% interval for net P&L/trade. Recompute ratio from resampled trades, report undefined zero-trade replicates. Prespecified 4-week sensitivity; not independent-trade inference.
evaluation.baseline: No trade: unchanged GBP1000 and zero trading P&L, not a generated strategy
robustness: C1 and C2 reported as sensitivity, never alternative winning models
C0 expectancy after removal of five largest winners
All missing-data exclusions, invalidations, exposures and funding rejections reported
evaluation.PROMISING: At least 100 completed C0 trades and required week coverage; positive C0 expectancy with positive lower 95% bound under both block lengths; positive C1/C2 expectancy; C0 profit factor >1.10; marked drawdown <=GBP100; no unresolved path; invalidation rate <1%; net positive after removing five largest winners; no material execution/data-integrity finding. Exploratory, not trading authorization.
evaluation.NOT_VIABLE: Valid complete adequately sized C0 sample with 95% upper expectancy bound <=0 under both block lengths, or a predefined GBP100 drawdown/risk/funding failure without material data-integrity bias
evaluation.INCONCLUSIVE: Any other evaluated case, including insufficient trades, conflicting sensitivities or material unresolved cost/latency realism
evaluation.stop: No untouched data => DATA REQUIRED before evaluation. Unknown capital or GBP100 peak-to-trough loss => stop financial processing, preserve partial results. Never restart or top up. Evaluate sample once; no tuning, boundary moves, alternative pairs or sessions.

limitations: No new strategy implementation or historical engine invocation in this task
Existing frozen matrix runner only permits old strategy names; this hypothesis needs a narrow later adapter, not silent replacement of an old strategy
No untouched evidence currently exists; all economic metrics are unavailable
Design informed by old diagnostics cannot make that old holdout fresh again
No authorization to collect data, access accounts, trade or start another phase
